comparison.objective: Assemble a mini chopper, twist-lock its top, and pulse it; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade placement, bayonet seating, bowl stabilization, twist locking, and button pressing versus concentric driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Blade and top remain assembled and exactly one valid pulse occurs; candidate must retain a calibrated 90° opening across three released cycles.
comparison.reason: Although both include locking and functional actuation, bayonet assembly does not test preserving a continuously adjustable screw setting while tightening its jam nut.
